classification.difficultyReason: Construct a dot plot from a short list of integer observations.

content.prompt:
The ages in years of the 14 members of a sporting team are:

$23,\ 19,\ 18,\ 19,\ 23,\ 25,\ 22,\ 22,\ 19,\ 22,\ 18,\ 23,\ 24,\ 21$

Construct a dot plot.

answer.worked: Use an equally spaced age axis from 18 to 25 years. Place one dot for each member, stacking dots above repeated ages: two at 18, three at 19, none at 20, one at 21, three at 22, three at 23, one at 24 and one at 25. There are 14 dots altogether.

spec.description: One dot per supplied age, stacked above equally spaced integer ticks.
